# Data Protection

[![Documentation](https://jcdc.dev/badge/Documentation/primary/book)](https://docs.jcdc.dev/umbraco-community-dataprotection/latest)
[![Umbraco Marketplace](https://jcdc.dev/badge/Umbraco%20Marketplace/umbraco/umbraco)](https://marketplace.umbraco.com/package/Umbraco.Community.DataProtection)
[![GitHub](https://jcdc.dev/badge/GitHub/github/github)](https://github.com/jcdcdev/Umbraco.Community.DataProtection)
[![NuGet package downloads](https://jcdc.dev/badge/nuget/Umbraco.Community.DataProtection)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/Umbraco.Community.DataProtection)
[![Project Website](https://jcdc.dev/badge/Project%20Website/primary/laptop)](https://jcdc.dev/umbraco-packages/data-protection)



Simple [ASP.NET Core Data Protection](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/aspnet/core/security/data-protection/introduction) for Umbraco CMS.

Data protection keys are stored in the Umbraco database.

> [!IMPORTANT]
> Version 13 will only receive security updates and no new features.

> Please review the [security policy](https://github.com/jcdcdev/Umbraco.Community.DataProtection?tab=security-ov-file#supported-versions) for more information.

## Installation

### Install Package

```powershell
dotnet add package Umbraco.Community.DataProtection
```

## Security

> [!NOTE]
